refvals/ — the refval-exp batch's phase-0 row: a RECORD-VALUED map,
`HashMap<i64, Pt>` — the suite's first bench row whose values are
REFERENCE values (rut records are shared cells, RFC 0044). It runs the
`[?V]` sidecar path (ArrKind::Opt cells for ref V) — the path the
experiment's `refcolumn` row (phase 1) will re-spell over the host val
column, so this row is the baseline the verdict is judged against and
permanent coverage either way. A module dir (not a loose file) because
it mounts `nmapset`, which pulls the `nmap_host` host pkg through its
own `[deps]`. `ink` is declared for the logger.
name: refvals
